description: Generate secret-style project codenames — adjective + noun combos like 'Silent Falcon', with optional number suffixes.

faqs.a: Each codename pairs an evocative adjective with a strong noun: 'Crimson Vortex', 'Silent Falcon'.
Optional — toggle the numeric suffix for names like 'Iron Badger 7'.
10 fresh codenames per click, all unique within the batch.
Click any codename to copy it instantly.

howto: Toggle the number suffix if you want it.
Click any codename to copy it.
title: Codename Generator
